edit.description: the unshippable read, whose containment arm is keyed on the work entry's own tag, and the refusal line it composes
the ship-consult refusal cases, over a nested step beside the entry-tag one

summary: a `shipped` list that would leave a substep's parent gone is refused, whichever offered tag the omission sits under — not the work entry's alone
acceptance: the unshippable read refuses a declared set that is not closed downward over the offered subtree — for every tag it names, every offered entry whose `parent` is that tag is named too, with the work entry's own arm as one case of that rule rather than a clause of its own — so no ledger rewrite can remove a file another queued entry's `parent` names; a partial list naming a leaf step alone, and one naming the entry with every step, still ship
tests: a shipped list naming a step without its own substeps is refused as unshippable
a wave whose shipped list omits a named step's substep leaves the queue parseable at the tip
pins: a shipped list naming a leaf step alone ships that step and leaves its entry queued
a shipped list naming the entry and every step ships them all
notes: `unshippableTags` (`src/waveMerge.ts:1361`) refuses a foreign tag and the entry's tag without every step, then returns `undefined` for any list the entry's tag is absent from. Steps nest, so the documented partial list (`src/Phase.ts:1012`) naming a mid-level step without its substeps has the rewrite remove that file and the next queue read refuse at `src/PendingSchema.ts:941` — exit 69. Collides with the gated-tip entry on this module by design.
